title: National Status and Passport with Daniel Mentz
description:
https://www.commonerlaw.com/national-status-welcome

Americans assume the law applies to everyone the same way. It does not. This special presentation explains why the law treats some Americans differently—not because of privilege or power, but because of legal status and standing.

In this recorded live session, Daniel Mentz of Sacred Honor Educational Fellowship walks through a topic that is often misunderstood, misrepresented, or dismissed, and explains it from history, law, and a tested and documented process.

In this presentation, you’ll learn:
• Why legal status precedes enforcement
• The historical distinction between U.S. citizenship and national standing
• How classification quietly affects jurisdiction, paperwork, and treatment
• Why the U.S. passport reflects more than travel privileges
• What lawful status correction means—and what it does not mean

This presentation will give you enough information and clarity to decide whether further you want to learn more.

Free Educational Resource
If you’d like to go deeper, you can start with the complimentary eBookThe Status Awakening. Uncover the hidden history of American citizenship and reclaim your standing. Get the free eBook here:
https://www.commonerlaw.com/national-status-welcome

Hosted by Clint Griess of Commoner Law Group, this session was created for an audience already familiar with questions of law, jurisdiction, and remedy—and looking for coherent explanations rather than internet shortcuts.
